title: 1801 Prairie's slate over its south return runs on to the gable
items: On the Kimball house at 1801 Prairie, the slate over the stone return beside the round bay's balcony now runs on as one face to the gable, topped by the ridge of the short roof behind the gable, as the 1965 survey photograph shows. The extra fold of slate that rose from the return to the hood beside the gable is gone.
